title: Black hole

# Black hole

A black hole is a region of spacetime where gravity is so strong that nothing, not even light, can escape. The boundary is called the event horizon.

## Formation

Stellar black holes form when a massive star collapses at the end of its life cycle, after a supernova.

# Black Sea

The Black Sea is a marginal sea of the Atlantic Ocean between Europe and Asia. It is bordered by Turkey, Bulgaria, Romania, Ukraine, Russia and Georgia.
